title: Arabic reading methodology and premise audit

reading_index.reference_rule: Work IDs, return-point IDs and evidence IDs are stable references to these exact indexes. JSON pointers refer to the original bound index. The owner projection retains the scientific content while redacting private custody locators.
reading_index.availability: The separately hashed reading-index projection belongs to the existing reading archive. An original identity does not select its body.

stage_definitions.name: Continuous first pass
stage_definitions.criterion: Traverse the selected received body in order, with actual textual or visual receipt boundaries. A received fragment or selected volume remains a fragment or selection.
stage_definitions.credit: Original first-pass receipts only. Text extraction and scan reading retain their separate scope.

stage_definitions.name: Local return during the wider first pass
stage_definitions.criterion: Revisit a completed section or volume while the larger selected body is still being traversed.
stage_definitions.credit: A real bounded reread where receipted, but it does not satisfy the post-whole-structure condition of AR-S2.

stage_definitions.name: Reflective primary return after whole selected structure
stage_definitions.criterion: The record establishes that the selected body was understood as a whole before this direct primary return. Knowledge of the whole historical work is not implied.
stage_definitions.credit: Only the receipted return; a later synthesis of notes earns no additional primary-reading credit. If temporal ordering is uncertain, do not promote the return to this class.

stage_definitions.name: Question or model triggered primary return
stage_definitions.criterion: An existing receipt links direct primary inspection to a newly salient question, premise, model, countermodel or objection. This category can overlap AR-S1R or AR-S2.
stage_definitions.credit: The trigger and date must be evidenced. Mere relevance or a later juxtaposition does not establish a causal research history.

stage_definitions.name: Methodological synthesis and audit
stage_definitions.criterion: Inspect existing receipts, interpretations, dependency maps and results to describe their relationship.
stage_definitions.credit: Zero new primary-reading credit and zero new proof-replay credit unless a separate new receipt records such work.

topics.strongest_existing_context_for_this_ques: Asbahani main 47–107, especially 65–68, 96–104; Safadiyya S002L0043–0046 and the intrinsic-attribute discussion. The first context was read continuously by direct images, not inferred from a keyword hit.
topics.interpretative_result: The concrete bearer and its intrinsic qualifications must be distinguished from a mental common description. Necessary existence alone does not identify the complete actual Maker.
topics.formal_dependency_or_result: OriginalBearerBridge A/B/C map: completion, realisation, support transport and contingency-as-need remain substantive premises; the same witness is tracked.
topics.remaining_obligation: The conditional proof does not independently warrant contingency-as-need or constitutive mode-invariance. Current provisional Necessary Being acceptance is inherited from the dated appraisal.

topics.strongest_existing_context_for_this_ques: Asbahani 65–68 and 96–104; the full Akmaliyya answer, especially its concrete self and inseparable attributes discussion; Darʾ 8 P0396–P0422.
topics.interpretative_result: Intrinsic self-sufficiency is not efficient self-production. A qualified original resource, its bearer, a proximate act and complete common provision must retain separate types.
topics.formal_dependency_or_result: A original_bearer_of_completion; C essential_nonreceipt_of_actual_original; the field bridge needs further G/H premises.
topics.remaining_obligation: A minimally warranted original bearer does not by that fact supply every contribution or every disconnected domain.
topics.reading_gap_decision: EXISTING_CONTEXT_CHECKED; no newly identified decision-relevant source-context gap requiring another primary reread in this audit. This is bounded by the retained corpus and present questions, not an assertion of exhaustive literature coverage.

topics.strongest_existing_context_for_this_ques: Darʾ 9 section 016:627–650 and 700–779; Shifaʾ e49–54 and e143–151; Miftah main 90–91.
topics.interpretative_result: The same numerical contribution, same respect, entire original production and merely having ability to act alone are not interchangeable. Type-level similarity or differentiated cooperation does not duplicate the same complete production.
topics.formal_dependency_or_result: CNDModalScope requires role retention and complete matching attribution; AnchoredSourceBridge obtains coverage before applying FieldCND to uniqueness.
topics.remaining_obligation: CND does not supply modal role retention, connectedness, source-mode perfection or exhaustive scope. Finite consistency is not metaphysical possibility.
topics.reading_gap_decision: EXISTING_CONTEXT_CHECKED; no newly identified decision-relevant source-context gap requiring another primary reread in this audit. This is bounded by the retained corpus and present questions, not an assertion of exhaustive literature coverage.

topics.strongest_existing_context_for_this_ques: Darʾ maker/preserver and harmony contexts; Minhaj realised efficacy and voluntary particularisation; Sawaʿiq strict supremacy and responsive acts.
topics.interpretative_result: The sources positively argue from effective capacity and appropriate perfection; they do not merely overlook harmony. The disputed transfer from product interdependence to producer receipt or defect is exposed rather than treated as automatic.
topics.formal_dependency_or_result: F separates qualification, classification and conformance; G separates use soundness and role applicability; H adds anchor and genuine connectedness. Deletion controls diagnose these dependencies.
topics.remaining_obligation: Universal SourceMode remains insufficiently warranted in the 14:34 assessment. Actual common original provision is provisionally accepted on separate residual integration/economy grounds, with lower confidence than Necessary Being.
topics.reading_gap_decision: EXISTING_CONTEXT_CHECKED; no newly identified decision-relevant source-context gap requiring another primary reread in this audit. This is bounded by the retained corpus and present questions, not an assertion of exhaustive literature coverage.

topics.strongest_existing_context_for_this_ques: Jamiʿ printed 179–182, E183–186; Shifaʾ genuine secondary efficacy; Miftah 501–502; Safadiyya intrinsic act, produced product and source account.
topics.interpretative_result: Possessing a power differs from jointly attaining an end. Original support need not erase a created agent’s own act, nor adopt that agent’s false assertion.
topics.formal_dependency_or_result: JointFinite mixed_occurrence_real, J12_support_not_ownership and J13_genuine_agent_identity; field contribution types preserve agency.
topics.remaining_obligation: The finite interpretation establishes compatibility and exposes equivocation. It does not identify the actual productive account of a particular event.

topics.strongest_existing_context_for_this_ques: Asbahani main 396–468; Shifaʾ e205–209 and e219–221; Miftah main 1024–1026 in its wider moral-value and suffering discussion.
topics.interpretative_result: A fitting timed response or completion of a product need not confer the maker’s intrinsic perfection from outside. Intrinsic conditions and source-created conditions are not independent donations.
topics.formal_dependency_or_result: The F conformance/classification split and JointFinite actual fitting nonspeech exercise retain this distinction.
topics.remaining_obligation: The content of an all-context fittingness norm, including whether a proposed overriding good can license a deficient assertion, remains a substantive warrant question.

topics.strongest_existing_context_for_this_ques: Asbahani 411–419, 422–423, 430–431 and 444–450 distinguishes reported Muʿtazilite reasoning, al-Razi’s criticism and Ibn Taymiyya’s reply. Sawaʿiq adds broader meaning and evidence-ranking controls.
topics.interpretative_result: A false source-owned deliberate presentation, deficient exercise, all-context unfitness and actual practical conformance are different predicates. The rescue or overriding-good objection targets the no-fitting-shortcoming premise.
topics.formal_dependency_or_result: VeracityBoundary controlled_token_true and veracity_of_coverage; deletion_N and truthful_not_conforming keep the proof and converse limits explicit.
topics.remaining_obligation: Arabic discussion does not independently prove the entire modern K/D/N/P signature. Source knowledge/ownership coverage and N require warrant, not a kernel substitution.

topics.interpretative_result: An accurate later account may preserve or strengthen knowledge without being its original cause. Multiple carriers or routes need a dependency analysis before being counted as independent.

topics.interpretative_result: Faithful content preservation does not reproduce the acoustic event, create an independent origin or identify a source from content alone. Repetition of one realised observation does not accumulate independent information.

topics.remaining_obligation: A real origin map and independent channel-noise evidence must be supplied. The trace model intentionally leaves source labels unobserved; it is not a theorem about all possible evidence for authorship.

new_primary_reading.reason: The audit found existing contextual checks for each currently decision-relevant premise. Remaining open questions concern warrant, actual attribution, interpretation or applicability. Repeating a passage merely to populate a three-stage label would add no independent evidence.
new_primary_reading.search_limit: The strongest relevant basis here means within the retained read corpus and the specified live questions, not a claim to have exhausted all available scholarship.

repetition_controls: A reread can correct an interpretation or expose a premise without adding an independent witness.
Distinct readers of the same received text do not multiply manuscript testimony; agreement is not a warrant vote.
A translation, electronic transcription, scan and excerpt can represent overlapping witnesses; their custody identities and dependencies remain in the reading index.
A repeated observation is not an independent sample. A genuinely independent acquisition or channel requires evidence of that independence.
First-pass continuous coverage, bounded visual controls, editorial apparatus and historical reconstruction remain different achievements.
Study seals establish the recorded coverage and file identities, not historical truth, metaphysical possibility or philosophical warrant.

assessment_control.statement: dot provisionally accepts a Necessary Being and actual complete common original source, with lower confidence in the latter; universal SourceMode remains insufficiently warranted. Basic Creator-recognition epistemic admissibility is retained. Earlier differing appraisals remain historical evidence.

credit: This supplement is AR-S4 synthesis of existing records. It adds no primary reading, theorem, proof replay, independent witness or historical authentication.
